description: Impact of photovoltaic irrigation system is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Shridhar Patil. The dataset used in this study comprises primary household-level survey data collected from farming households in semi-arid agricultural systems of central India. Data were gathered from 223 farm households, including 108 adopters of photovoltaic irrigation systems (PVIS) and 115 non-adopters, across 17 villages in two administrative blocks. Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
